prompt.project_info: Create an energetic luxury-lifestyle flash photograph using the attached adult reference for face, hair, clothing, and accessories.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult seated on a bed ledge, holding a fanned stack of Japanese 10,000-yen bills at chest level and looking upward with an exaggerated celebratory expression. Preserve the reference face, hair, body type, skin tone, clothing, jewelry, and accessories.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 low-angle environmental portrait. The subject sits on the bed ledge with legs comfortably positioned, both hands holding the cash fan. Include scattered yen bills on the surface, a yellow designer-style bag in the background, and the reference bedroom setting.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Night photography with clean warm room lights and direct camera flash, creating contrast and highlights on the subject and props. Energetic, celebratory, aspirational luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical, low angle from below, close environmental portrait, flash photography, warm contrast color palette, realistic cash, fabric, skin, and bedroom texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved adult reference image to maintain exact consistency with the person's face, hair, body type, skin tone, clothing, jewelry, and accessories. Create a vertical 9:16 night flash photograph of the adult seated on a bed ledge, holding a large fanned stack of Japanese 10,000-yen bills in both hands at chest level, looking upward with an exaggerated energetic celebratory expression. Include scattered yen bills on the surface and a yellow designer-style bag visible in the background. Low-angle environmental portrait, clean warm room lights mixed with direct camera flash, realistic highlights and shadows, luxury lifestyle photography, warm contrast tones, detailed natural textures.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, identity drift, counterfeit text, unreadable money, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, watermark

assets.name: approved adult reference subject
assets.usage: Preserve face, hair, body type, skin tone, clothing, and accessories; replaceable only with another approved adult reference.

assets.name: Japanese yen cash prop
assets.usage: Preserve fanned and scattered cash arrangement and recognizable currency context without inventing counterfeit details.

assets.name: yellow designer-style bag and jewelry

assets.name: reference bedroom
assets.usage: Preserve bed, room lighting, and background structure; replaceable with an equivalent warm bedroom.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview to lock adult identity, outfit, cash arrangement, bedroom, and flash lighting. Keep identity and props consistent; cash, bag, and room can be replaced only with equivalent references. Do not add unrelated logos, text, or branded details.
